pillar_reactions.evidence: Confirmed without questions — 'Does that kind of align with what you're looking for in terms of like a methodology?' / 'Yeah, yeah, definitely.' He had pre-sold himself on the modality before the call and articulated the efficiency argument himself: 'It's an all-in-one type of resource that will allow me to accomplish a lot in a shorter period of time instead of having to spend a half an hour just working on bicep focus.' He also named the mobility benefit unprompted as part of what attracted him.

The clear standout of the call and the only place he volunteered feeling: 'it oddly excites me to have somebody that... it's going to be compatible with my lifestyle, with what I like, what I don't.' He then tied it straight to his household — his wife loves it when he cooks, she is chasing similar goals, and the three children eat incompatibly — concluding 'this will help facilitate her eating healthy as well' and asking for 'a sustainable diet plan, something that we can build off of, work with, and use for years to come.' Notably this enthusiasm was for a plan built on a diet the rep never asked a single question about.

Understood and agreed without questions — 'Does that make sense?' / 'Yes.' He had already scoped down what he wanted from it: 'as far as motivation is concerned, I don't think that's going to be an issue. If I commit to something, I'll do it' and later 'I don't need a wake-up call.' What he did want was schedule flexibility, and he got a direct answer — 'as long as you get it done that day, you're fine' — which resolved the only friction in the pillar.

anchors.raw: I purchased a set of kettlebells... they were $260 a kettlebell, but anyways
anchors.note: He bought an adjustable set at $260 a bell on the strength of a few social videos, and the 'but anyways' says the number did not detain him. Demonstrated category spend before any conversation happened, and a sunk investment that makes not proceeding feel wasteful.

anchors.raw: I'm not very patient when it comes to things like that. I pull the trigger and I see something I like pretty quickly.
anchors.note: Self-declared fast decision-maker, said aloud at minute four. This is the anchor that made the call close and it also explains why no objection ever surfaced. Worth noting for the audit: a buyer like this will absorb a weak process without exposing it.

anchors.raw: most of our clients are business owners. We can frame it like the invoice in whatever ways necessary to write off for tax as well. I know once, for example, we even framed it as workplace injury prevention
anchors.note: Offered unprompted immediately after the price and received warmly — 'Good. Good. I like that.' Functions as a post-hoc discount without moving the number. Fourth appearance of this lever in the batch and the second in the explicit invoice-shaping form.

anchors.raw: So Trevor, there's a bunch of others that I saw, but Trevor caught my attention, then I looked into the program
anchors.competitor: other kettlebell creators surfaced by social algorithms
anchors.note: The weakest anchor on the call and effectively neutralised — he had already selected Trevor out of the field before arriving. Recorded because it is the standing alternative in this acquisition channel: a feed full of free instruction from competing coaches, one of whom he happened to pick.

unmet_demand.want: Resolution of lower back irritation and sciatic symptoms provoked by loaded lifting
unmet_demand.why_unmet: It was promised rather than assessed — 'making sure diet's locked, backs fixed, progressing' — on the basis of the rep's own scoliosis experience. The offer contains no clinical assessment, no clearance step and no route to a clinician, so the outcome most explicitly sold to him is the one the programme is least equipped to guarantee.

unmet_demand.want: A nutrition plan that carries his wife and works around three children with incompatible diets — a stated reason for buying
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The programme is a one-to-one tailored plan for the client. The rep affirmed the household benefit ('It will definitely help her') without qualification, but nothing in the offer is scoped to a second adult or to family meal planning. Whether it delivers what he is expecting is untested.

unmet_demand.want: Integration with supplements and treatments he is already on — 'we'll go through like all the supplements I currently take, he'll take note of any kind of supplements or treatments that I'm on and build that into everything'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep answered with an unqualified 'Absolutely. Everything. It's literally all encompassed with everything.' The prospect referenced unspecified treatments, which were never asked about. Committing to build around undisclosed medical treatments is a promise the offer has no mechanism to keep.
